2. Run the bump (lead only): npm run version:minor  — writes version.json version=6.102.0 with releaseDate=2026-10-15 (UTC).

3. Manual pin-site updates (lead only): package.json version -> 6.102.0; root manifest.json version -> 6.102.0; readme.md one-liner pins (lines 37,43,53,71,78,83,110,115,125,130,144,145,150,188,192) v6.100.0 -> v6.102.0. Do NOT touch readme.md line 67 (historical release note) or example lines 253/254/262/263/265/349/362. changelog.md is NOT edited on bump (per 08-minor-bump prompt); release notes are generated from commit history.
4. Commit via gitmap (lead only): stage the changed files with the staging flow and push to main (e.g. gitmap cpf / gitmap cpb per house convention).
5. Wait for the CI Build run on that commit to go fully green (v6.100.0 lesson: never tag from a red/yellow commit).

6. Cut and push the tag (lead only): git tag v6.102.0 && git push origin v6.102.0. The tag triggers release.yml: create-release-page publishes the GitHub Release page immediately as non-draft, then setup, build-sdk, build-xpath/build-macro-controller/build-prompts, then release packages the 18 assets, uploads them, forces rich notes via gh release edit, and the final gate runs node scripts/check-release-assets.mjs.
7. Watch with ETA-based waits, no rapid polling: gitmap pipeline-ai status --json, re-check on a measured cadence (e.g. every 5-10 minutes) until the Release run completes.

8. Verify the published release (lead only): gh release view v6.102.0 --repo alimtvnetwork/macro-ahk-v55 --json assets — confirm all 18 assets present; optional 19th checksums.txt.minisig appears only when MINISIGN_SECRET_KEY is configured.
9. COMPENSATION RULE: if the Release workflow fails, fix FORWARD - correct the underlying issue, commit, and cut a new patch tag (e.g. v6.102.1). NEVER rewrite or move the published v6.102.0 tag.
